summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Annapurna Chem Solutions MVP. All 12 backend pytest tests passed (orders CRUD, contact form, health, validation, persistence). All key frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright: Home, Products listing, Place Order (form submit → success page with order ID), Track Order (valid + invalid), Contact form, Admin Dashboard (orders table, status update modal), About page, and mobile menu toggle. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: Returns 200 OK on create instead of 201 Created (minor REST convention deviation)

logger is initialized AFTER it is first referenced inside send_order_email_placeholder; works at call time but module-level order is fragile. Move logging.basicConfig and logger above route definitions.
No server-side validation of `status` enum (accepts any string). Should restrict to pending/processing/shipped/delivered/cancelled.
Deprecated FastAPI event handler; use lifespan context manager.

issues: The 'Made with Emergent' floating badge overlaps the bottom of the mobile menu/CTA area at small viewports — minor; not blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Return 201 from POST /api/orders and POST /api/contact for REST correctness.
Add status enum validation to PATCH /api/orders/{id} via Pydantic Literal/Enum.
Move `logger` initialization above `send_order_email_placeholder` to avoid NameError risk if module load order changes.
Migrate `@app.on_event('shutdown')` to FastAPI lifespan handler (deprecation warning).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined at module bottom but referenced inside send_order_email_placeholder defined above. Works because function body executes later, but is brittle.
PATCH /api/orders accepts any arbitrary status string — no enum constraint. Could lead to invalid statuses being persisted.
Admin dashboard is publicly accessible at /admin without any guard (acknowledged MVP decision).
Email integration is a placeholder (logs only) — clearly flagged. Real sending requires SENDGRID_API_KEY.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests; consider explicit origins for prod.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this MVP
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed orders and inquiries through the API. No cleanup endpoint exists; test data remains in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers full Order CRUD + Contact + health + validation. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Order ID format: ORD-{8 hex upper}. Email sending is MOCKED (logs only) — flagged as expected behavior. Admin dashboard at /admin requires no auth. Frontend has rich data-testid coverage.
